title: autoducks plugin manifest (plugin.json)
description:
Contract for a plugin package's plugin.json manifest. There is no ajv/jsonschema tooling in this repo: this file is a machine-readable reference that the shell validators (core/config/load-config.sh, core/config/resolve-prompt.sh, setup.sh) check field-by-field with jq, plus a shared reference for the on-disk package layout every downstream task builds against:
  hooks/<agent>-<stage>/action.yml        - one dir per hook point, see $defs.hookPoint for the 26 valid names
  prompts/instructions.md                 - global prompt fragment, injected when prompts.global is true
  prompts/agents/<agent>/instructions.md  - per-agent prompt fragment, injected when <agent> is listed in prompts.agents
  claude/mcp.json                         - MCP server definitions; names referenced by mcpServers
  claude/hooks.json                       - Claude Code hook definitions; events referenced by claudeHooks
  claude/settings.patch.json              - settings merge patch applied on top of the base claude/settings

schemaVersion.description: Manifest schema version. Only 1 exists today.

name.description: Kebab-case, unique plugin identifier, e.g. "playwright-browser". Must match [a-z0-9-].

version.description: The plugin's own semver version, e.g. "1.2.0".

description.description: One-line human-readable summary of what the plugin does.

homepage.description: Canonical URL for the plugin's source/docs, e.g. its repository.

autoducksVersion.description: Compat gate against the host autoducks.json top-level "version", e.g. ">=0.4.0". Optional comparison operator (>=, <=, >, <, =) followed by a semver triple; no operator means exact match.

targets.description: Subset of the 10 LLM-backed agents (see $defs.llmAgent) this plugin scopes its claude/ + prompts/ contributions to. Omit this field entirely to target all 10 agents.

hooks.description: Hook points this plugin contributes, each of which must have a matching hooks/<agent>-<stage>/action.yml directory in the package. Must be drawn from the 26 valid <agent>-<stage> names in $defs.hookPoint.

global.description: When true, prompts/instructions.md is injected into every targeted agent's context.

agents.description: Agents for which prompts/agents/<agent>/instructions.md is injected. Each entry must be one of the 10 LLM agents in $defs.llmAgent, and a corresponding prompts/agents/<agent>/instructions.md file must exist in the package.

prompts.description: Prompt contributions. Both fields are optional; omit the whole object if the plugin contributes no prompt text.

mcpServers.description: MCP server names this plugin registers. Each name must match an entry in the package's claude/mcp.json.

claudeHooks.description: Claude Code hook lifecycle events this plugin wires up. Each event must match an entry in the package's claude/hooks.json.

allowedTools.description: Tool names (built-in or mcp__<server>__<tool>) this plugin needs allow-listed in the host's claude settings.

requiresSecrets.description: Advisory-only list of environment/secret names the plugin expects the host repository to provide (e.g. for its MCP servers or hooks). Not enforced by the loader.

configSchema.description: A JSON Schema fragment (typically { "type": "object", "properties": {...} }) describing the shape of the enablement entry's "config" object in autoducks.json's plugins[] array. Validated field-by-field by the shell loader, not by a JSON Schema engine.

llmAgent.description: One of the 10 LLM-backed agents: architect, engineer, developer, reviewer, fix, resolver, rework, defer, product, agent. (The remaining pipeline/utility agents - close, close-guard, maestro, revert - are pure orchestration and never run an LLM step, so they are not valid targets/prompts.agents entries.)

hookPoint.description: One of the 26 valid <agent>-<stage> hook-point names: the 13 pipeline/utility agents (agent, architect, close, defer, developer, engineer, fix, maestro, product, resolver, revert, reviewer, rework) each crossed with the 2 stages every agent workflow runs (pre, post - matching that agent's pre.sh/post.sh hand-off points, or the equivalent boundary in the agents that ship a single run.sh). close-guard is an internal guard step, not an addressable hook point.

claudeHookEvent.description: A Claude Code hook lifecycle event name, as used in claude/hooks.json.

sourceGrammar.description: Grammar for the "source" field of a plugins[] enablement entry in autoducks.json (see $defs.enablementEntry). Exactly one form: a vendored on-disk path ("./relative/path" or ".autoducks/plugins/<name>"), or "github:owner/repo@ref" with the @ref required (floating/unpinned refs are refused), or the registry:name@version form reserved for a future package registry.

enablementEntry.description: Shape of one entry in autoducks.json's top-level "plugins" array (the enablement contract, distinct from the plugin.json manifest validated by the root of this schema).

name.description: Must match the "name" in the referenced plugin's plugin.json.

config.description: Plugin-specific configuration, validated against that plugin's configSchema.
